name: Randomised trial of a bioengineered skin substitute with scar quality as the primary endpoint

design.model: acute full-thickness surgical wounds or chronic ulcers
design.readout: POSAS observer and patient scores at 12 months; appendage presence and nerve-fibre density on optional biopsy
design.n: powered for a POSAS difference; to be calculated

discriminates: Improved scar quality means the constructs do more than accelerate closure; no difference means the capability is closure only.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (PubMed) and Crossref metadata, checked 2026-09-11; no source opened at figure level
